title: Quezon’s ‘Gamble’: PH sheltering Jewish refugees recalled
summary: Original poker cards owned by former President Manuel Quezon are on display at the Quezon Memorial Shrine in Quezon City as part of an exhibit revisiting his decision to shelter Jewish refugees…

blocks.text: Original poker cards owned by former President Manuel Quezon are on display at the Quezon Memorial Shrine in Quezon City as part of an exhibit revisiting his decision to shelter Jewish refugees fleeing Nazi persecution in Europe before the breakout of World War II. The exhibit, titled “Ai360: Gamble of Compassion,” opened on Oct. 29
